findings: SpaceTimeModel selects checkpoints by lexicographically sorted .pth names, then parses six filename characters for step after loading. Original isolated method confirms missing explicit path falls back to directory checkpoint; arbitrary custom filename can fail step parsing after loader invocation; no_reload skips loading. Fake loader only, no weights deserialized.

Training inner break is global_step > start_step+n_iters+1 while outer loop is < that bound: a sufficiently long loader can execute one extra update. Static control-flow finding, not full training measurement.
Depth-invalid or renderer-skip batches do not advance global_step; an empty/all-skipped training set can repeat epochs indefinitely. Validation next(cycle(empty_loader)) can spin. Static assessment.
Training seeds NumPy from entropy each epoch and worker; declared deterministic worker_init_fn is not the DataLoader callback actually passed. No reproducibility gate established.

Training uses Criterion for synthesis plus unmasked image PSNR logging; no call to flow smoothness or independent min-max normalization appears in these three files. Other callers not yet exhaustively searched.
RAFT optimizer parameters are separate when train_raft, but explicit post-backward gradient sanitization loops only feature/decoder learnable_params. No runtime impact asserted.

Demo consumes exactly two lowercase png/jpg paths, estimates DPT disparity and optical flow, then RANSAC homography; no corpus search, duplicate classifier or exact-byte confirmation. PNG group precedes JPG group rather than joint basename sort.

Homography path has no explicit empty-valid-flow percentile guard or missing-H fallback. Depth outputs are paired by sorted index initially, then get_input_data expects image basename including extension for PNG disparity outputs; mixed/JPG inputs require further producer inspection.
Demo generates four camera trajectories, 60/60/60/90 frames, fixed 32-pixel crop and MP4 output; synthesis visual output does not certify duplicate equivalence.
